      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes parameter handling in `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp` for node RPCs `createrawtransaction` and `createpsbt` using `-deprecatedrpc=bip125`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Standard deprecation gating for obsolete RPC arguments is worthwhile interface maintenance. Deprecating `replaceable` enforces RPC deprecation discipline for callers relying on explicit BIP 125 signalling now that full-RBF is standard."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only relocates BIP 125 documentation comments into `src/util/rbf.h` without altering shared utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Touching `rbf.h` solely for comment relocation does not make this PR a change to shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp` and `src/wallet/spend.cpp` across eight wallet RPC endpoints.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Cleaning up redundant BIP 125 opt-in sequencing arguments simplifies transaction creation across eight wallet RPCs. Because full-RBF has been standard since v28, opt-in replaceability is redundant, making its staged deprecation worthwhile interface maintenance."
